load_audio_from_file: load audio from a file or bytes into a CPU or CUDA buffer using spdl.io.load_audio
load_video_from_file: load video from a file or bytes into a CPU or CUDA buffer using spdl.io.load_video
load_image_from_file: load an image from a file or bytes into a CPU or CUDA buffer using spdl.io.load_image
batch_load_images: batch load multiple images into a single buffer with optional resizing using spdl.io.load_image_batch
save_image_to_file: save a numpy array as an image file in rgb24, gray, or yuv444p format using spdl.io.save_image
